title: Лабораторна робота (EN)
summary: Students of the Institute for Applied System Analysis at Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute have compared two transformer models that write short summaries of news articles . The students also checked the summaries by hand and noticed that both models mostly copy whole sentences from the beginning of the text . They plan to repeat the experiment with Ukrainian news next semester .

title: Лабораторна робота (EN)
summary: Students of the Institute for Applied System Analysis at Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute fine-tuned BART and T5 on twenty thousand stories. Each model read the first five hundred tokens of an article and learned to produce three or four sentences that describe the main events. The larger BART model needed more than twice as much time per epoch.

title: Технології (EN, вигадана компанія)
summary: Voltera plant will process up to 10,000 tonnes of batteries a year and employ about 250 people . Car makers face new rules that require a growing share of recycled metals in batteries sold from 2030 . Environmental groups welcomed the project but said more collection points were needed, because many small batteries from phones and scooters still end up in household waste .
